pages.hook: The New York subway is one of the busiest in the world and many people use it every day. Learn a few words and you can travel across the city like a local.

mythfact.why: It is one of the few big subway systems that does not close at night.

mythfact.s: All trains stop at every station.
mythfact.why: Express trains skip stations, and local trains stop at every one.

mythfact.s: “Uptown” means going toward the north part of Manhattan.
mythfact.why: Uptown = north, downtown = south in Manhattan.

mythfact.s: You must always talk loudly to a stranger on the train.
mythfact.why: Most people are quiet, and it is normal to keep to yourself.

pages.title: Reading quest — My first subway ride in New York · part 1
text: Yesterday I took the subway in New York for the first time. I was very nervous. The station was big, loud and full of people. I wanted to go to Brooklyn, but I did not know which train to take.

I saw a man with a map and said, “**Excuse me, which train goes to Brooklyn?**” “**Take the number two train**,” he said. “Where is the platform?” I asked. “**Go down the stairs. It’s on the left**,” he answered.

I went down the stairs and found the platform. A train came with a loud noise. I asked a woman, “**How many stops?**” She said, “**Four stops. Get off at Atlantic Avenue**.” I thanked her and got on the train.

opts: A first subway ride in New York
fast.why: The writer takes the subway for the first time.

pages.title: Reading quest — My first subway ride in New York · part 2
text: The train was a local, so it stopped at every station. It was slow, but I did not mind. I counted the stops: one, two, three, four. A voice said, “The next stop is Atlantic Avenue.”
I got off, went up the stairs and walked into the sun. A smiling man at the exit said, “**Have a good trip!**” It was a small moment, but I felt very happy.
Now I know that the subway is not scary. You can always ask for help, and most people are kind.

pages.title: Boss mission — Taking the subway

brief.teacher: You are Ravi. Change the plan during the scene.
brief.student: You are in a New York subway station. Ravi is a traveler. Help him get to Brooklyn. You are the customer / visitor.

orders: The farm is across the field.
complications: The other person did not hear you: repeat.

pages.title: Free production
pages.prompt: Descreva o passeio de carro. Diga que passam pela estação, atravessam o túnel e a fazenda fica do outro lado do campo. Ligue à referência The Little Engine That Could: abre a situação para praticar “descrever movimento: past (passando por), through (através de) e across (do outro lado de)”.
pages.model: We go past the station. We go through the tunnel. The farm is across the field. The Little Engine That Could helps here.

tasks.name: Say it
tasks.prompt: A fazenda fica do outro lado do campo.
tasks.model: The farm is across the field.

items: Make a list: bus, train, subway, taxi.
Review: Which train goes to…? / How many stops?
